                                      Report of a Committee.
     By Mr. Rodrigues, for the committee on Ways and Means, that the Senate Bill relative          Wrongful
to compensation for victims of wrongful conviction (Senate, No. 1132),-- ought to pass with        conviction,--
                                                                                                   compensation.
an amendment substituting a new draft with the same title (Senate, No. 3300).
     There being no objection, the rules were suspended, on motion of Ms. Jehlen and
the bill was read a second time and was amended, as recommended by the committee
on Ways and Means.
     The bill (Senate, No. 3300) was then ordered to a third reading.
                                  PAPERS FROM THE HOUSE

      Releasing certain land use restrictions held by the commonwealth in a certain parcel of      Bills laid before the
